The '''Outer Rim Concourse''' was a concourse located aboard [[Tomorrowland Starport]] that supplied registration for flights to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], including [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
This location was mentioned in a video screen advertisement found exclusively in the queue of the [[Tokyo Disneyland]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction.<ref name="ST" />

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1stm}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
